acceptance: Rows M2 and M3 pass a full simulated cycle on their only route; M4 passes or stays open on an X9 cause
The run is deterministic on macOS and Linux CI, with no real LLM CLI
isolation.Rows and the §14 table mark the rows green
fix: Give the matrix harness (go/cmd/evolve/e2e_cycle_cli_matrix_test.go) a tmux route: a private tmux server with a fake REPL (fakeclitest, as the bridge real-tmux tests do), or a headless driver per family. Then flip M2, M3 and M4 green in isolation.Rows.
source: console builder X6, 2026-10-25, follow-up of PR #1123 (ADR-0154)
summary: After X6 the floor no longer blocks rows M2 to M4 (floors {} in the matrix policy). A bare family routes to its tmux driver (agy-tmux, agy-claude-tmux, codex-tmux), and the matrix harness has no tmux REPL fake: a stub tmux refuses, so each row fails with 'new-session: exit status 1'. With a real tmux on PATH the fake CLI never answers the REPL and the cycle times out after 300 s. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §10 status and §14.
title: LLM isolation X1b: the substitution matrix gets a tmux REPL fake, so rows M2 to M4 can run a full cycle
